jobs.job_title: Junior AI Engineer: Build Real-World ML for Business
jobs.job_description:
Lamdax in Riyadh invites a Fresh Graduate AI Engineer to help build practical AI solutions. You will apply academic knowledge to real business problems, collaborate with software engineers, and contribute to data-driven decisions.

The role focuses on developing and testing ML models, deploying and monitoring AI in production, and preparing datasets. A strong foundation in Python, SQL, .NET, and major ML frameworks is expected, with internships or projects as evidence.

Develop, deploy, and integrate scalable AI and machine learning solutions to automate business processes, enhance operational efficiency, and support data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning models to address business needs.

• Develop and integrate AI solutions, including LLMs and APIs, with existing enterprise systems.

• Build predictive analytics models to support forecasting and business performance.

• Prepare, analyze, and process complex datasets for AI model development.

• Monitor, evaluate, and optimize AI models to ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance.

• Collaborate with business teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into technical solutions.

• Apply MLOps practices to support scalable and secure AI deployment.

• Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and AI ethical standards.

Qualification and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Strong proficiency in Python, machine learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs).

• Experience in API development, AI integration, and MLOps.

• Experience in deploying secure and scalable AI solutions in production environments.

Role Purpose:

The FWA AI Engineer is responsible for designing, building, testing, and deploying AI solutions that support Fraud, Waste & Abuse (FWA) detection and investigation. The role translates approved business requirements and data science models into scalable production solutions, integrating AI capabilities into operational workflows while ensuring reliability, performance, and business value. Working closely with the FWA Lead, FWA Data Scientist, investigators, and business stakeholders, the role drives the successful implementation and continuous enhancement of FWA AI use cases.

Key Accountabilities:

1- FWA Solution Design & Feasibility Assessment;

Assess technical feasibility of approved FWA use cases.

Evaluate data availability, technical requirements, and implementation complexity.

Define solution approaches for AI-driven FWA detection.

Develop technical requirements and implementation plans.

Recommend optimal AI techniques and technologies for delivery.

2- AI Solution Development & Engineering;

Build and optimize AI solutions supporting FWA detection and investigation activities.

Translate models and analytical logic into scalable cloud-native solutions on GCP.

Implement machine learning, anomaly detection, graph analytics, and document intelligence solutions.

Develop APIs, scoring services, and integration components required for operational deployment.

Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with technical standards.

Collaborate with the FWA Data Scientist to operationalize validated models.

3- Production Deployment & Integration;

Deploy AI solutions into operational environments.

Integrate AI outputs with internal systems and workflows.

Coordinate with Data Engineering and TIDES (IT) teams to enable production deployment.

Support release planning and deployment activities.

Ensure successful transition from development to production.

4- Testing & Quality Assurance;

Conduct technical testing of AI solutions.

Support user acceptance testing with business stakeholders.

Validate output accuracy, reliability, and performance.

Identify and resolve implementation issues.

Ensure solutions meet defined business and technical requirements.

5- Solution Maintenance & Continuous Improvement;

Support ongoing enhancement of deployed FWA AI solutions.

Implement model improvements identified by the Data Science team.

Address technical issues and optimize solution performance.

Incorporate new fraud detection capabilities and business requirements.

Maintain technical documentation and solution knowledge assets.

Bupa Arabia is a healthcare insurance company based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. We are an associate business of Bupa Group, which is a global healthcare company with an international reach that extends across multiple business operations, practices, and resources.

Founded in October 1997, Bupa Arabia was initially established through a partnership between Bupa Global International and Nazer Group, with the key focus to provide health insurance services with high quality and competitive prices, while ensuring a distinctive experience for customers. Bupa Arabia has since evolved into a fully Saudi-owned and operated company. Our transformation from a joint venture into a publicly traded company on the Saudi Stock Exchange occurred in 2008, as we made 40% of our shares available to the public during our Initial Public Offering (IPO).

As a subsidiary of the global Bupa Group, we draw upon international expertise while maintaining a profound understanding of local healthcare requirements and regulations. This allows us to offer comprehensive healthcare insurance solutions tailored to the unique needs of the Saudi Arabian market.

Bupa Arabia prides itself on its commitment to the wellbeing and development of its employees, providing them with the same standard of care, support, and professionalism that it expects to be delivered to its customers.

You will design, build, and deploy production AI systems for real-world challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and development, collaborating with researchers and embedded engineers.

Responsibilities include evaluating AI systems, contributing to open‑source tools, and mentoring partner staff while delivering measurable improvements and responsible AI practices.
